# Counseling and Psychiatry on Dargan

> CAP on Dargan is a collaboration of independent psychiatry and psychology providers under one roof in Florence, South Carolina. The clinic is at 523 South Dargan Street. Phone (843) 503-1235. Emergency services are not available on site.
